name: The Seed Vault of Impossible Plants
description: A sub-arctic vault carved into a glacier, housing glowing seeds of plants that don't exist yet -- flowers that bloom in vacuum, trees that grow on sound, vines that weave bridges between stars. Each seed shows its future form as a holographic projection.
prompt: Interior of a massive vault carved into blue glacial ice. Walls lined with frozen niches holding glowing seeds in crystal suspension. Each seed projects a holographic preview of its mature form: a flower blooming in vacuum (petals catching solar wind), a tree growing on sound waves (rings visible as audio waveforms), vines weaving bridges between asteroids, moss that photosynthesizes starlight, cacti storing time instead of water. Projections are translucent, rotating slowly. Vault ceiling: ice embedded with frozen aurora. Automated tenders (silent, geometric) maintain perfect conditions. Cold blue lighting with warm seed-glow contrast. Scientific wonder meets botanical fantasy.
caption: The future is sleeping in ice. 🌱❄️ Flowers for vacuum. Trees that eat sound. Vines for star-bridges. Each seed dreams its hologram into the cold air. Which impossible plant would you wake first?
